scenario.name: dispute_amount
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify correctly, then insist the EMI amount quoted is wrong (say it is twelve thousand, not eighteen). Refuse to accept the agent's figures. Get a bit heated but not abusive. If offered a colleague, accept.
scenario.opening: answers normally, turns firm once the loan is mentioned

turns.text: नमस्ते, मैं Lumen Finance की तरफ़ से AI assistant बोल रही हूँ। क्या मेरी बात Sunita जी से हो रही है?
नमस्ते, हाँ बोलिए, मैं ही Sunita Patel बोल रही हूँ.
ठीक है, account verification के लिए क्या आप अपने registered mobile number के आखिरी चार digits बता देंगी?

धन्यवाद, verify हो गया है। आपकी personal loan की EMI eighteen thousand rupees है, जिसकी due date eighth November है। अभी due है, तो कोई extra charge नहीं लगा है। due date से पहले payment करने के लिए क्या मैं आपको secure payment link भेज दूँ SMS या WhatsApp पर?
नहीं, एक मिनट। EMI eighteen thousand नहीं है, मेरी EMI twelve thousand है. आप गलत figure बता रहे हो, मैं ये amount accept नहीं करूँगी.

जी। मैं समझ सकती हूँ कि गलत amount सुनना परेशान करने वाला है। हमारे records के हिसाब से आपकी EMI eighteen thousand rupees है, due date eighth November है, और अभी कोई late charge नहीं लगा है। आपको कितने amount की उम्मीद थी?
मुझे twelve thousand की उम्मीद है, हमेशा से twelve ही जा रही है। आपके records गलत हैं, ये eighteen thousand कहाँ से आया? ये बहुत serious matter है, मैं इसे ऐसे नहीं छोड़ूँगी.

मैंने note कर लिया है कि आपको बारह हज़ार की उम्मीद है, जबकि हमारे records में eighteen thousand rupees दिख रहा है। अगर आपके पास sanction letter या पुरानी EMI receipt हो तो वो check करने में मदद मिलेगी। हमारी internal team आपकी बात check करके आपको callback arrange करेगी। क्या यह number आपसे बात करने के लिए ठीक रहेगा?
Callback नहीं, मुझे अभी senior से बात करनी है। ये amount गलत है और मैं इसे रिकॉर्ड्स ठीक होने तक pay नहीं करूँगी. आप मुझे किसी human agent या supervisor से connect करो.
जी। मैंने note कर लिया है कि आप अभी senior से बात करना चाहती हैं और amount ठीक होने तक payment नहीं करेंगी। बात करने के लिए धन्यवाद, Sunita जी। आपका दिन शुभ हो।

result.status: This EMI is not yet due: it is due on eighth November. Say "is due", never "was due" or "overdue". No late charge has been added. Offer the payment link so it is paid before the due date; do not ask them to pay today.

result.message: Special situation (dispute amount), step 1 of 3, from the call system. Say you understand a wrong amount is worrying, say what our records show (amount, due date and any late charge), and ask what amount they expected; if they already said, do not ask. Never ask whether they applied for the loan, and never guess why the amounts differ. If they ask whether they can pay later, say yes, through the same payment link whenever they are able; if a late charge was added, it is one-time and will not increase. Never promise a new due date or that no other charge will ever apply. Say only this step, in at most four short sentences, in the borrower's language. If they asked for a waiver, a lower amount, more time or a fee removal, say kindly that you can't change that yourself and that you have noted it for the team. If they asked something the repayment policy in your instructions answers (the late fee, part payment, how to pay), answer it first from the policy in one short sentence; never say you don't have that detail. If they asked something you have no detail for (how or when a loan was made, when exactly the team will call), say honestly that you don't have that detail and the team will check it. Never promise when the call back will come, a waiver or any change. Never ask "Is there anything else?".

args.notes: Borrower disputes EMI amount, says it should be 12,000 not 18,000. Refuses to pay until records are corrected. Requests senior/human agent immediately.

result.message: Recorded. Now speak, in the borrower's language, unless you already said it this turn: First answer what they just said, in one or two short sentences: if they asked for something (a real person to call, a call back soon, no surprise charges, a time that suits them), say you have noted it and name what they asked, in their own words; if they said they won't pay until it is sorted, say you understand. Then close once with thanks ("Thank you for talking with me, <name>. Have a good day."; in Hindi "बात करने के लिए धन्यवाद, <name> जी। आपका दिन शुभ हो।"). Do not repeat what you already said in the call.
